channel.title: Wildcard Watch: Broadcom
channel.description: Exploited vulnerabilities and attacks involving Broadcom, each with its fix status and first step.

item.title: Patch now: Broadcom VMware vCenter: Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel
item.description:
Broadcom VMware vCenter: Authentication bypass · internet-facing · exploited · fix: 9.1.1.0200, 9.0.2.0200, 8.0 U3m

First step: Update Broadcom VMware vCenter to the fixed version for your release line (for example 9.1.1.0200, 9.0.2.0200 or 8.0 U3m).

Broadcom VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access to vCenter to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system.

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-123890

item.title: Patch: Broadcom VMware ESX: Insufficient Logging
item.description:
Broadcom VMware ESX: exploited · fix: 5.2.4, ESXi-9.1.0.0-25370933, ESXi-9.0.2.0100-25595025

First step: Update Broadcom VMware ESX to the fixed version for your release line (for example 5.2.4, ESXi-9.1.0.0-25370933 or ESXi-9.0.2.0100-25595025).

Broadcom VMWare ESX contains an insufficient logging vulnerability that could allow a malicious actor with admin access to perform certain operations without being logged.

Low · Fix available · CVE-2026-41709
